title: Waves, tides and ocean currents
quote: Waves carry energy, not water; tides follow the moon and sun; currents redistribute heat

boxes.title: Waves & tsunamis
items: **Wavelength** = crest to crest; **height** = crest to trough
**Swells**: long-period, from distant storms; **breakers**: break when depth < half the wavelength
**Kallakkadal**: Kerala swell surge from storms ~**10,000 km** away; pre-monsoon
**Rip currents**: narrow fast channels ==away from shore==
**Tsunami** = "harbour wave": sea-floor displacement; up to **800 km/h**

boxes.title: Tide causes & types
items: Moon (greater) + sun gravity; **centrifugal force** counters
**Direct tide** = gravity (moon side); **indirect tide** = centrifugal (opposite)
**Semi-diurnal** (2 high + 2 low, most common), **diurnal**, **mixed**
High tides every ==**12 h 25 min**==; **perigean**: moon closest
**Bay of Fundy** (Canada): ==world's greatest tidal range==; **Gulf of Khambhat** 5-10 m (~**7,000 MW**)

boxes.title: Indian Ocean & effects
items: N. Indian Ocean currents ==**reverse with the monsoon**==
**WICC**: northward **Nov-Feb**; southward in SW monsoon
**Findlater**: Somali Jet; upwelling off Horn of Africa
Cold currents → deserts: **Atacama** (Humboldt), **Namib** (Benguela), Sonoran (California)
Warm + cold meet → fishing + fog: **Grand Banks** (Gulf Stream + Labrador), Japan
